question: What milestone did Virat Kohli achieve in the 2025 IPL season (as of 15 April, 2025)?

options.text: Registering a combined total of 1000 fours and sixes in IPL history

solution:
The correct answer is __**Registering a combined total of 1000 fours and sixes in IPL history**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Virat Kohli **became the first player in IPL history to achieve the milestone of **registering a combined total of 1000 fours and sixes** as of April 15, 2025.
 
• The milestone includes a career record of over **850 fours and 150 sixes**, showcasing his consistency and dominance as a batsman in the league.
 
• Kohli has been a part of the IPL since its inception in 2008 and has represented **Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB)** throughout his IPL career.
 
• This achievement underscores Kohli's role as one of the most prolific run-scorers in IPL history, further solidifying his legacy in T20 cricket.
 
• He has also been the **leading run-scorer in IPL history**, with over 7000 runs to his name as of 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Premier League (IPL):**

 
 
• The IPL is a professional T20 cricket league in India, founded in 2008 by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
• It is one of the most popular and lucrative cricket leagues globally, featuring players from across the world.
 
• The league consists of **10 franchise teams** representing different cities in India (as of 2025).
 
• Notable records in the IPL include most runs, most wickets, and highest individual scores in a match.
 
 
 
• **Virat Kohli:**
 
 
• Virat Kohli is regarded as one of the greatest batsmen of all time, known for his consistency across all formats of cricket.
 
• He has represented India in all three formats and has captained the national team across various tournaments.
 
• Kohli holds several records, including being the fastest to 8000, 9000, 10000, 11000, and 12000 ODI runs.
 
• In IPL, he holds the record for the most runs scored in a single season (973 runs in 2016).
 
 
 
• **T20 Cricket:**
 
 
• T20 cricket is a shorter format of the game, with each team playing a maximum of 20 overs.
 
• It emphasizes aggressive batting, innovative bowling, and quick fielding to achieve results within a few hours.
 
• The format has gained immense popularity due to its fast-paced nature and entertainment value.
 
 
 
• **Milestones in IPL:**
 
 
• Several players have achieved unique milestones, including **Chris Gayle** (most sixes in IPL history) and **Lasith Malinga** (most wickets in IPL history).
 
• Milestones like 1000 fours and sixes reflect a player's ability to consistently score boundaries, a critical skill in T20 cricket.
 
• Such records highlight the evolution of cricket as a sport and the growing emphasis on strike rates and scoring efficiency.
